## Search intent

Primary keyword: **linkedin post**
Secondary: how to post on linkedin, linkedin post length

Write for the person who typed the primary keyword and wants to stop typing. The
first 40 words answer them; everything after that is for the reader who needs the
detail. If the honest answer is "it depends", say what it depends on in that first
paragraph rather than making them scroll for it.

## Required outline

1. What the reader is trying to do
2. How the system actually works
3. The parts, one H2 each, every one linking down to its spoke
4. What to do first
5. FAQ

## Tools this post exists to feed

- [`linkedin-post-preview`](/tools/linkedin-post-preview) - LinkedIn Post Preview: See exactly where “…see more” cuts your post.
- [`carousel-splitter`](/tools/carousel-splitter) - Carousel Splitter: One wide image, sliced into panels that line up when you swipe.
- [`social-media-character-counter`](/tools/social-media-character-counter) - Social Media Character Counter: One box, every platform’s limit, and exactly where each one cuts you off.

At least one `[[tool:slug]]` card goes in the body at the moment the reader needs
it - not parked at the end. Link `/tools/<slug>` in prose as well, with the tool's
own name as the anchor.
